description: Analyze test flakiness across CI runs: per-test pass/fail/skip history, evidence runs, flakiness rates and classifications, a quarantine list at a configurable threshold, summary counts, and a verdict.

min_runs.description: Minimum evidence runs (passes + failures) before a test is classified as stable or flaky (optional, default 2)

quarantine_threshold.description: Flakiness-rate threshold for the quarantine list (optional, default 0.5)

runs.description: CI runs to analyze (at least one)

results.description: Test results in the run (at least one)

status.description: Test outcome: passed, failed, or skipped

name: analyze_test_flakiness
